name: io.github.Unselfisheologism/supercarto
description: Token-budgeted map context for any coordinate: OSM graph, terrain, weather, daylight, GTFS transit
title: supercarto

environmentVariables.name: SUPERCARTO_OWM_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenWeatherMap key; enables the traffic tool

environmentVariables.name: SUPERCARTO_GTFS_URL
environmentVariables.description: GTFS static feed zip URL; enables the transit tools

environmentVariables.name: SUPERCARTO_GTFS_RT
environmentVariables.description: GTFS realtime TripUpdates URL; joins predictions into schedule rows
